name: gate-model-full

netlist_source_forced.why: klt sim accepts only 'schematic'/'extracted'; this netlist is gate-level, generated from trng_digital.routed.v plus one Liberty deck. Disclosed deviation, not a claim about the netlist's level.

phases.name: reset-released register audit: ID, HT_STARTUP, STATUS (EN=0)
register pops + interleaved reads (first raw word readable)

realisation: timed-delay XSPICE netlist (d_genlut / d_dff + adc/dac bridges)

reductions.c_load: sum of Liberty input-pin capacitance of the receivers on the net, plus port_load_pf on a net that reaches a module output port
reductions.dff: clk_delay/set_delay/reset_delay = 1e-12 s (XSPICE's own floor; it refuses 0), ic = 0; one scalar rise/fall pair per flop covers the CLK->Q and async clear/preset arcs
reductions.input_load: Liberty input-pin capacitance per d_genlut input -- NOT the DR-0017 boundary-load choice (option 1 vs 2 is open, #431)
reductions.nldm_reduction: bilinear interpolation at (slew, C_load), clamped to the table index range, max over every delay arc to the pin
reductions.supply_axis: corners.supply_v alone does NOT re-corner the digital half; the Liberty deck must move with the (T, Vdd) point
